investments.paywall_text: Connect Bybit, keep a trade journal and track your crypto portfolio. Upgrade to Pro or Ultra to unlock the section.

investments.pos_note_placeholder: Why did you take this trade?
investments.note_add_placeholder: What's the story behind this trade?
investments.hold_intro: For assets outside your connected exchange account — a cold wallet, staking, another exchange. Selling from a connected account shows up in the journal instead, not here.
investments.hold_delete_confirm: Delete this asset from the portfolio?
investments.hold_empty: Portfolio is empty — add an asset or connect an exchange
investments.hold_no_price_hint: No USDT ticker on Bybit or the price is temporarily unavailable. Not included in the portfolio value.
investments.acc_howto_step1: On Bybit open API → Create New Key → System-generated API Keys.
investments.acc_howto_step2: Choose the Read-Only permission — keys with trade permissions are rejected.
investments.acc_howto_step3: Add our server's IP to the key's whitelist: without it Bybit expires the key after 3 months and the sync will stop; with a whitelist the key never expires.
investments.acc_howto_safety: The key can only read your trade history — trading or withdrawing funds with it is physically impossible.
investments.acc_key_trade_permissions: This key has trade permissions. Re-create the key on Bybit with the Read-Only type.
investments.spot_fifo_hint: A spot position is assembled from buys and sells by FIFO: a sell closes the oldest buys, the entry price is volume-weighted, and the open date is the oldest closed buy. Coins bought outside Bybit (deposits) do not become trades.
